cohort: 46 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and 184 COVID-19-negative pregnant women who delivered between January 1 and August 31, 2021, at Chonburi Hospital, Thailand.
finding: There were no significant differences in neonates with APGAR of less than 7 between the cohort of 46 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and those who tested negative.
mod_finding: COVID-19-positive pregnant women had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to COVID-19-negative pregnant women.
